findings.claim: VAST Data's December 2024 EBox description specifies three SCM drives and nine 30TB NVMe SSDs.
VAST Data's July 2026 SMC Gen2 EBox BOM lists nine Solidigm D5-P5336 61.44TB PCIe 4 QLC U.2 drives per EBox.
NVIDIA's current DGX GB200 release notes independently document Micron NVMe drives in GB200/CX7-CX8 configurations.
DUG Technology, describing its VAST HPCaaS deployment, states that the architecture uses a large QLC flash tier behind Intel Optane cache.

specificity.platform: VAST storage used for DUG HPCaaS

later_nonmatching_surfaces.surface: 2026 EBox and Ceres V2 validated-drive lists
later_nonmatching_surfaces.finding: P5336 QLC is explicitly validated in later VAST platform documentation.
later_nonmatching_surfaces.why_not_2024_bridge: Later validation does not establish the identity of the unnamed nine 30TB NVMe SSDs in the December 2024 EBox article.

later_nonmatching_surfaces.finding: Later NVIDIA documentation explicitly names the Micron 9550 Gen5 SSD on DGX B300.
later_nonmatching_surfaces.why_not_gb200_bridge: B300 is a different NVIDIA platform generation and cannot independently establish the 2024 GB200 9550 RVL event.

reality_projection_disposition.reason: The corroboration packet is valuable as Evidence, but the strongest newly grounded claims do not map cleanly onto an existing canonical Reality predicate without either losing specificity or introducing a new semantic owner solely for this packet. The project stop rule favors preserving Evidence and assessment rather than creating an artificial Fact surface.

lead_dispositions.researcher_interpretation: QLC enterprise storage is no longer supported only by SSD-vendor self-statements: DUG supplies a named customer-owner deployment precedent, and VAST later publishes an explicit P5336 QLC BOM.
VAST's 2024 EBox configuration and later P5336 QLC BOM form a useful trajectory, but they cannot be collapsed into a claim that P5336 was the unnamed 30TB drive in 2024.

researcher_visible_boundary: Independent evidence strengthens the general deployment/integration trajectory while narrowing what remains unknown. Later specificity must not be used to rewrite earlier ambiguous configurations.
next_action: Stop repeating the same P5336/GB200 corroboration search unless a new primary surface appears. Advance to the next storage demand/adoption lead that can add a distinct customer workload, deployment scale, or directly measured consumption denominator while preserving the unresolved full-year QLC Outcome and 2024 same-product identity gaps.
